The REST module has four code sites that call `LocationService.saveLocation`, all in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest`. Best first:

1. **`LocationResource1_8.save`** (`openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_8/LocationResource1_8.java:221-224`). This is the main `/location` resource's create/update path. Any change to `saveLocation` affects every POST/update to `/ws/rest/v1/location`.
2. **`LocationAttributeResource1_9.save`** (`.../resource/openmrs1_9/LocationAttributeResource1_9.java:85-103`). It adds the attribute to its parent location and then saves the location (line 101).
3. **`LocationAttributeResource1_9.delete`** (same file, `:109-114`). It soft-deletes an attribute by setting `voided` and then calls `saveLocation` (line 113), so it depends on `saveLocation` persisting voids.
4. **Tests in `LocationController1_9Test`** (`.../web/v1_0/controller/openmrs1_9/LocationController1_9Test.java`). These call `service.saveLocation` directly as test setup: lines 164, 225 and 242, inside `shouldOverwriteAListOfChildLocations` (`:159-174`), `shouldIncludeTheParentLocation` (`:220-234`) and `shouldIncludeTheListOfChildLocations` (`:236-250`). They would break if `saveLocation`'s behaviour changed, so they are useful regression signals.

Core definitions that the REST module depends on, for reference (outside the REST module, so not in the JSON below): `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/LocationService.java:68`, `.../api/impl/LocationServiceImpl.java:67`, `.../api/db/LocationDAO.java:33` and `.../api/db/hibernate/HibernateLocationDAO.java:56`.

I did not check the generic `DelegatingCrudResource` base class in the REST module, which is what dispatches create/update to `save(...)`. Other `LocationService` calls in the module (`getLocation*`, `purgeLocation`, tag lookups) don't call `saveLocation`, so they are not listed.
